races.name: Powell & Construction Poultry Buildings Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Un Sens A La Vie
runners_data.note: Leading with superior class rating but 74 days off and needs to prove fitness first time back

runners_data.name: Not For Passin
runners_data.note: Front-running style with solid recent form but significant class deficit to face

runners_data.name: Snatch A Glance
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with excellent going record and 5lb claimer reducing weight burden

runners_data.name: Latin
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse struggling on good ground with poor recent form over hurdles

runners_data.name: Sonic Pioneer
runners_data.note: Hold-up style but 88 days since last run and 7lb claimer may lack race sharpness

runners_data.name: Winston's Oath
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with low weight but concerning recent form decline

races.paceDynamic: Un Sens A La Vie and Not For Passin will set the early pace in this small field, with Un Sens A La Vie's superior class likely establishing control after the initial skirmishing. The honest gallop will string out the field over 2 miles, with Snatch A Glance and Winston's Oath tracking in prominent positions while Latin and Sonic Pioneer attempt to close from the rear. The sustained pace and small field size creates a tactical race where prominent runners can cover moves and kick clear, while hold-up horses face limited opportunities to weave through. This race shape clearly favours prominent runners who can stay close to the pace and have something left to quicken.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is honest but not excessive, allowing prominent runners to stay in touch
scenarios.body: The sustained gallop suits horses tracking the leaders who can kick clear in the straight without needing gaps. Snatch A Glance's consistent form and Winston's Oath's prominence both benefit from this tactical setup.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Class Tells Up Front
scenarios.trigger: If Un Sens A La Vie uses superior rating to control from the front and repel challengers
scenarios.body: His OR 130 and proven ability at this level allows him to dictate terms and kick clear when challenged. The small field means less pressure from behind to maintain a searching gallop throughout.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes too strong and the leaders come back to the closers
scenarios.body: Latin and Sonic Pioneer benefit from a collapse up front, with their stamina coming into play in the final furlong. However, the small field limits their ability to find cover and make smooth progress.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Lottery
scenarios.trigger: If both leaders go too fast early and stop completely in the straight
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish between whoever has energy left regardless of running style. This unlikely scenario opens the door for any horse that conserved energy in the early stages.

watchPoints.text: Un Sens A La Vie's jumping under pressure after lengthy absence - any mistakes could prove costly given his front-running role
Latin's ability to handle good going as his record shows clear preference for softer surfaces
Not For Passin and Un Sens A La Vie's early battle intensity - if too fierce both could pay late
Snatch A Glance's position tracking the leaders to ensure she doesn't get caught wide without cover
Sonic Pioneer's movement in the market given the long layoff and 7lb claiming allowance

races.name: Templar Medical Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Maximum Offers
runners_data.note: Prominent style suits this tactical setup perfectly, excellent recent form and Gavin Sheehan booking adds confidence

runners_data.name: Springs A Girl
runners_data.note: Hold-up style needs the pace to develop, but her course win in December and Harry Atkins' 7lb claim are notable factors
runners_data.comment: On workable mark but she's been up and down in handicaps and others are more persuasive
runners_data.spotlight: Won a novice here (2m5f, good to soft) in December 2024 but she's been up and down in handicaps since; finished second of five at Newbury (3m, soft) in February but she didn't fire at Chepstow (2m3f) last time; now goes back up in trip and down in grade but this is competitive and others are more persuasive.

runners_data.name: Noonetellsmenothin
runners_data.note: Prominent racer with solid recent form, but the 5-year-old faces experienced handicappers in testing conditions

runners_data.name: The Egyptian Ginge
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who needs luck in running, amateur rider Mr Jamie Neild takes 7lb off but adds tactical risk

runners_data.name: Catwalk Girl
runners_data.note: Natural front runner with light weight advantage, but Tom Broughton's 5lb claim may not offset inexperience over this trip

runners_data.name: Tzarmix
runners_data.note: Hold-up style suits if pace develops, but 64 days off the track and needs to reproduce his winter soft ground form

runners_data.name: Windsor Blue
runners_data.note: Prominent style fits the race shape, but inconsistent recent efforts raise questions about her handicap mark
runners_data.comment: Won here (2m5f) in February but she failed to back that up on her return visit last month
runners_data.spotlight: Off the mark with 20-1 win in a handicap here (2m5f, soft) in February but she failed to back that up on her return visit last month; still has low mileage but she needs to resume her progress at this new trip.

races.paceDynamic: Catwalk Girl will take this field along as the sole confirmed front runner, setting what should be a manageable gallop over the 3m trip without early pressure. Maximum Offers and Noonetellsmenothin are likely to track prominently behind her, while The Egyptian Ginge, Springs A Girl and Tzarmix will need to be produced from off the pace. With limited early pace pressure, Catwalk Girl can dictate terms and potentially stretch the field late, but the sustained nature of the gallop should allow the hold-up horses to get into contention turning for home. This tactical setup favours prominent racers who can track the pace and kick, as they'll have positional advantage without facing a punishing early gallop.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Late
scenarios.trigger: If Catwalk Girl sets a steady tempo and tires approaching the final flight
scenarios.body: The prominent trackers get first run on a weakening leader and have enough left to resist the late closers. Maximum Offers and Noonetellsmenothin are perfectly positioned to capitalise.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Catwalk Girl gets an easy lead and quickens turning for home
scenarios.body: Her light weight and fresh form allow her to stretch clear before the field can respond effectively. The hold-up horses find too much to do from their patient positions.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Surge Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is too steady and the race becomes a sprint from the last
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses with stronger finishing kicks overhaul the pace-setters who've had no cover. Springs A Girl and Tzarmix find their rhythm too late but with devastating effect.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Battle Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If Maximum Offers or Noonetellsmenothin press Catwalk Girl earlier than expected
scenarios.body: The increased tempo compromises all the early leaders and sets up a finish for the patient hold-up horses. Springs A Girl's December Ludlow win becomes highly relevant.

watchPoints.text: Catwalk Girl's jumping under pressure - if she makes an error at a crucial flight, it opens up the race completely
The Egyptian Ginge's position turning for home - amateur jockey Mr Jamie Neild needs to have her close enough to strike
Maximum Offers tracking the leader - if Gavin Sheehan lets him get too far back, his prominent style becomes compromised
Springs A Girl's jumping rhythm - she needs to travel smoothly to set up her trademark late challenge
Early pace development between Catwalk Girl and the prominent trackers - any early battle changes all calculations

races.name: Hr Smith Handicap Chase (For The Boyne Cup) (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Almazhar Garde
runners_data.note: Confirmed front-runner returning after 32 days off with solid course form but faces stamina test at maximum trip

runners_data.name: Petty Cash
runners_data.note: Classic hold-up performer with Henry Daly stable in good form, ideally positioned if strong pace develops

runners_data.name: Tax For Max
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with proven stamina over 3m+ trips, trainer out of form but horse shows consistent effort levels

runners_data.name: Annie Express
runners_data.note: Prominent runner carrying 6lb penalty for recent course win, inexperienced claiming jockey a tactical concern
runners_data.comment: C&D winner who scored in good style over 2m4f here last time; big player again up 6lb
runners_data.spotlight: Has a patchy profile but she made it 2-6 over fences when justifying favouritism here (2m4f, good) last month; up 6lb but that was a personal best last time and her other chase win came over this C&D; key player.

runners_data.name: Gris Majeur
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with excellent recent form including two seconds, 11-day turnaround suggests confidence from connections

runners_data.name: Epic West
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning from 69-day break with strong trainer/jockey combination, distance and fitness questions remain

runners_data.name: Zacony Rebel
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse receiving significant weight allowance but showing declining form over past six months

runners_data.name: Arrycan
runners_data.note: Prominent runner making seasonal debut after 193 days off, age and fitness concerns against proven recent form

races.paceDynamic: Almazhar Garde will set the pace from the front with Annie Express and Epic West tracking close behind in the early stages. The presence of multiple prominent runners (Almazhar Garde, Annie Express, Epic West, Arrycan) suggests a contested early gallop that could develop into a searching pace over the extended 3m trip. With five hold-up horses (Petty Cash, Tax For Max, Gris Majeur, Zacony Rebel) positioned at the back, the field will stretch out considerably. This race shape clearly favours the hold-up performers who can benefit from the pace and finish strongly up the hill.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Pace Benefits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If Almazhar Garde, Annie Express and Epic West engage early and maintain a strong gallop
scenarios.body: The sustained pace will set up perfectly for the hold-up horses who can unleash finishing kicks. Tax For Max and Petty Cash are ideally positioned to capitalise with their proven stamina reserves.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runners Control Tempo
scenarios.trigger: If Almazhar Garde dictates a more conservative pace without early pressure
scenarios.body: The lack of pace pressure allows the leader to control proceedings and kick away from the front. Annie Express can track and pounce late while the hold-up horses struggle for finishing room.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mid-Race Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace proves too strong and several prominent runners fade badly
scenarios.body: Epic West and Arrycan, sitting just off the pace, can inherit the lead as others tire. The hold-up horses face a tactical nightmare with no pace to aim at late on.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Stamina Test Eliminates Many
scenarios.trigger: If the combination of pace and 3m distance proves too demanding for most
scenarios.body: Only the most genuine stayers survive with Gris Majeur's recent form putting him in prime position. Zacony Rebel's low weight becomes a crucial advantage in a war of attrition.

watchPoints.text: Almazhar Garde must prove stamina at this extended trip having never won beyond 2m5f previously
Annie Express faces significant step up in class while carrying penalty weight with inexperienced jockey aboard
Epic West returning from lengthy absence needs to prove fitness in what could become stamina-sapping contest
Tax For Max has ideal racing weight and style for this pace scenario despite trainer's recent poor strike rate
Gris Majeur's quick return suggests stable confidence after two solid seconds in similar company recently

races.name: Powell & Company Construction Stables & Buildings Mares' Novices' Limited Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Kottayam
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning from 184-day break, which is a significant concern for fitness despite decent recent form

runners_data.name: Imperial Pride

runners_data.name: Lady Dapple Rose
runners_data.note: Clear front runner who can dictate pace, but trainer Harriet Dickin has concerning 0/8 record in last 14 days

runners_data.name: After Many Days

runners_data.name: Jlow
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist returning quickly from 10-day break, needs strong pace to be effective from rear

runners_data.name: La Cantate
runners_data.note: Prominent racer returning from 276-day layoff, major fitness concern despite previous ability

runners_data.name: Klervia
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with strong trainer form (Fergal O'Brien 7/25), Tom Broughton's 5lb claim valuable here

runners_data.name: Shes All Pride
runners_data.note: Hold-up mare who needs strong gallop, Lewis Stones' 3lb claim helps but trainer form poor

runners_data.name: Wishful Wings
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner with concerning fading pattern in recent finishes, question mark over stamina

runners_data.name: Jessie's Giant
runners_data.note: Needs strong pace from the rear but recent form suggests she's below her best level

runners_data.name: Slack Alice
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner who requires genuine pace test, Shane Fenelon's 5lb claim provides weight relief

races.paceDynamic: Lady Dapple Rose looks the only confirmed front runner in this field of predominantly prominent racers, giving her an uncontested lead from the start. With Imperial Pride, After Many Days, Kottayam, La Cantate, and Klervia all likely to settle in behind rather than challenge early, Lady Dapple Rose can dictate terms at a comfortable gallop over this staying trip. The hold-up horses Jlow, Shes All Pride, Wishful Wings, Jessie's Giant, and Slack Alice will be relying on the pace quickening late to bring them into contention. This sustainable pace scenario strongly favours front runners and prominent racers who can travel kindly in the early positions.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Front Runner Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Lady Dapple Rose gets an easy lead and isn't pressured early
scenarios.body: She can control the gallop perfectly over this stamina-sapping trip and have enough left to resist late challengers. Her front-running style is ideally suited to exploiting a weak pace with minimal early pressure.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Racers Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners travel too well behind the uncontested leader
scenarios.body: After Many Days and Imperial Pride can use their tactical speed to strike approaching the final flight when Lady Dapple Rose begins to tire. Their ability to sit handy but not commit early gives them the perfect position to exploit.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Rally Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If Lady Dapple Rose sets too slow a pace early and quickens it late
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses get the strong gallop they need in the final half-mile to unleash their finishing kicks. Jlow and Slack Alice benefit most from this stamina test turning into a sprint finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Benefits Outsiders
scenarios.trigger: If Lady Dapple Rose stops quickly and the prominent runners fail to capitalize
scenarios.body: The race becomes a scramble where position matters less than who handles the tactical nature best. La Cantate's long absence becomes irrelevant and Klervia's trainer form starts to tell.

watchPoints.text: Lady Dapple Rose getting too easy a time in front - if she's not under any pressure turning for home, she could be hard to catch
After Many Days and Imperial Pride tracking the leader too closely early - they need to conserve energy for their finishing kicks
Jlow settling last of all - if the pace is genuine she has the class to come from off the pace
Kottayam's fitness first time back after 184 days - watch for any signs of rustiness jumping the early hurdles
The pace through the first mile - if it's crawling, the hold-up horses come right into play

races.name: Powell & Company Construction Agricultural Buildings Mares' Open Maiden NH Flat Race (C3 Elim) (GBB)
Eddie Mapp Memorial Open Hunters' Chase

runners_data.name: Mr Glass
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with solid class (OR 112) who should track the leader comfortably and has recent winning form to build confidence.

runners_data.name: Fix At All
runners_data.note: Another prominent type who has been consistent in similar company and should be well-positioned to strike if the pace collapses.

runners_data.name: Potters Party
runners_data.note: Highest-rated runner (OR 122) whose prominent style suits the likely pace scenario, though recent form shows some inconsistency.

runners_data.name: The Paddy Pie
runners_data.note: Veteran campaigner returning after 368 days but armed with excellent recent hunter chase record of three wins from four starts.

runners_data.name: Prohus Yank
runners_data.note: Natural front runner who will relish the tactical advantage of an uncontested lead in this small field setup.

runners_data.name: Est Illic
runners_data.note: Lowest-rated participant (OR 69) whose prominent style may not be enough to bridge the significant class gap.

races.paceDynamic: Prohus Yank stands as the lone confirmed front runner in this small field of seven, meaning he can dictate terms without early pressure. The remaining six runners all show prominent tendencies, suggesting they'll track Prohus Yank in a compact group through the early stages. This creates a potentially soft lead scenario where the pace-setter can conserve energy before others commit. The tactical setup clearly favours those who can either sustain from the front or have the tactical speed to challenge the leader when he comes under pressure.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Soft Lead Holds Up
scenarios.trigger: If Prohus Yank gets an uncontested lead and stays resolute when challenged.
scenarios.body: The lack of genuine pace pressure allows him to find his rhythm and kick clear when others move up to him. His front-running style becomes a significant tactical advantage when he's not forced into a speed duel.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners successfully stalk Prohus Yank and one times their challenge perfectly.
scenarios.body: Mr Glass or Potters Party can use their higher class ratings to overhaul the leader in the final stages. Their ability to race handy while conserving energy pays dividends in a tactical finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Class Differential Shows
scenarios.trigger: If the higher-rated horses assert their superior ability despite tactical disadvantages.
scenarios.body: Potters Party (OR 122) or Mr Glass (OR 112) overcome any positional concerns through sheer class. The quality gap becomes decisive even if the race shape doesn't ideally suit them.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Veteran Experience Counts
scenarios.trigger: If The Paddy Pie's recent winning form and course familiarity overcome his lower rating.
scenarios.body: The 13-year-old's three wins from his last four hunter chase starts demonstrate he knows how to win these contests. His experience in reading the pace could prove crucial against higher-rated but less consistent rivals.

watchPoints.text: Prohus Yank getting too easy a lead - if he's not pressured early, he could prove very hard to peg back
Mr Glass and Potters Party settling well behind the leader - their class advantage needs tactical positioning to be effective
The Paddy Pie showing any signs of freshness despite the long layoff - his recent hunter chase record suggests he could be primed
Fix At All's jumping under pressure - his consistency depends on maintaining fluent leaping when the pace quickens
Track conditions staying consistent with the "Good" going reports throughout the card
